# CS Media

> CS MEDIA, LLC is a Kentucky-based real estate media company providing drone photography, cinematic video, interior/exterior photography, and virtual staging. FAA Part 107 certified. Based in Leitchfield, KY. Packages start at $185 with 24–48 hour delivery.

## About the business

- Owner: Hocheris Chanthavong
- Location: Leitchfield, Kentucky (Grayson County) — serves central Kentucky (Grayson, Hardin, Breckinridge, and Meade counties)
- Phone: +1-270-307-0173
- Email: cscreatesmediallc@gmail.com
- Pricing: $185 (Aerial Media Only — 10 aerial images, or 4 aerial images + up to 15s clip), $200 (Branding Content — up to 1-minute branding video, no photos), $285 (Photography Only — 25–40 MLS-ready photos, interior/exterior/aerial), $420 (Full Media Package — MLS-ready photos + up to 1-minute listing video, most popular); all packages are 3-hour sessions; virtual staging, if needed, is +$5 per photo or +$15 per video scene
- Add-ons: Twilight Edit +$25/photo, Rush Delivery 24hr +$40, Additional Photos +$5/image
- Revisions: 1 free per package (2 on Full Media Package); additional revisions $15 each; major edits quoted separately; requests must be submitted within 3 days of delivery
- Pricing notes: 6% Kentucky sales tax applied to final pricing; travel is included in every package price
- Turnaround: 24–48 hours for all deliverables
- Credentials: FAA Part 107 certified for commercial drone operations

## Services offered

- **Real Estate Photography** — Interior and exterior shoots with HDR processing and professional lighting
- **Drone Photography & Video** — FAA Part 107 certified aerial coverage of property, lot, and surroundings
- **Listing Video** — Up to a 1-minute walkthrough video, bundled into the Full Media Package ($420)
- **Virtual Staging** — Digital furnishing of empty rooms, if needed: +$5 per photo (or +$15 per video scene)

## Service areas

CS Media serves central Kentucky — Grayson, Hardin, Breckinridge, and Meade counties — with dedicated city pages for the primary markets:

- [Leitchfield, KY](https://www.cscreatesmedia.com/leitchfield-real-estate-photography): Home market (Grayson County). Farms, acreage, residential, and Rough River area rentals.
- [Elizabethtown, KY](https://www.cscreatesmedia.com/elizabethtown-real-estate-photography): Hardin County market — residential and Fort Knox-area properties
- [Radcliff, KY](https://www.cscreatesmedia.com/radcliff-real-estate-photography): Hardin County — Fort Knox-area properties (LAANC airspace)
- [Hardinsburg, KY](https://www.cscreatesmedia.com/hardinsburg-real-estate-photography): Breckinridge County — farms, hunting properties, Ohio River frontage
- [Brandenburg, KY](https://www.cscreatesmedia.com/brandenburg-real-estate-photography): Meade County — Doe Valley resort, Ohio River frontage
- [Caneyville, KY](https://www.cscreatesmedia.com/caneyville-real-estate-photography): Eastern Grayson County — local market

## Common questions

- Aerial Media Only is $185; Photography Only (25–40 MLS-ready photos, drone included) is $285; Branding Content (video only) is $200; Full Media Package (photos + up to 1-minute listing video) is $420
- All deliverables are returned within 24–48 hours of the shoot; 24-hour rush delivery is available for +$40
- Commercial drone work legally requires an FAA Part 107 certificate; CS Media is Part 107 certified
- Travel is included in every package price — no separate mileage fees; 6% Kentucky sales tax applies to the final price
- Virtual staging is an add-on, if needed, at +$5 per photo or +$15 per video scene
- Every package includes 1 free revision (2 on the Full Media Package); additional revisions are $15 each
- Service area covers central Kentucky (Grayson, Hardin, Breckinridge, and Meade counties)
